3 Results Here we evaluate the accuracy of GTDB-Tk classifications by applying it to a set of 10 156 phylogenetically diverse bacterial (9386 genomes) and archaeal (770 genomes) MAGs of varying genomic quality that were manually curated in GTDB R04-RS89.
Classifications for these MAGs took 14 hours wall time using 32 2.30 GHz Intel Xeon E5-2650 CPUs and required 100 GB of RAM.
2.4 Requirements GTDB-Tk is intended to run on a server with multiple CPUs and ≥128 GB of RAM.
It can classify ∼1000 genomes per hour when using 64 CPUs.
Importantly, the great majority of disagreements are confined to a single rank difference (1057 of 1071 cases; 98.7%).
